_comment: Tier D throughput run with the viewer attached (docs/performance.md, ROADMAP 4.10): the throughput stage with a CSV every tenth novel block and a visualize block; scripts/perf.ps1 runs it with TASFW_VISUALIZER_HEADLESS=1 so the viewer tails the run with no window and writes its cost summary, gated with the run's wall against the plain throughput run.
